appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Reservoir Storage Level Index'. Y-axis label is 'Storage index'; x-axis label is 'Year'. A single blue line connects ten black circular points, one per year from 2005 to 2014.

Each point has a numeric label above it: 23.9 (2005), 23.9 (2006), 21.4 (2007), 20.0 (2008), 17.9 (2009), 15.5 (2010), 15.3 (2011), 13.8 (2012), 11.3 (2013), 10.1 (2014). The line is flat between 2005-2006 and declines thereafter, with the steepest visible drop between 2012 and 2013.
Axis runs from 0 at the bottom to a top tick near 20, with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20. The 2005/2006 points sit visibly above the 20 tick; the 2014 point sits just above the 10 tick.
The series begins at the highest labeled value (23.9) in 2005 and ends at the lowest labeled value (10.1) in 2014, a net drop of roughly 13.8 index points, about 58% of the starting value.

'Whether the full-period reservoir storage change requires substantial-change follow-up'. Review scope: 'Reservoir Storage change, 2005-2014'.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the reservoir storage dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Comparison scope: full-period change from 2005 to 2014.

Routing options: (1) Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up; (2) Keep the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation; (3) Route the reservoir storage record to archive and background filing.
No numeric threshold for 'substantial change' is supplied in the policy tables or page instructions.
uncertain: No explicit quantitative threshold defining 'substantial change' vs 'ordinary variation' is provided on the dashboard or form.
The unit of 'Storage index' is not stated (index points only).
